title: Finite-dimensional strongly convex Gibbs LSI and Talagrand T2 backend
source_anchor: Otto-Villani, Journal of Functional Analysis 173(2), 2000, Theorems 1-2, as used in Lee-Shen-Tian arXiv:2010.03106v4 Lemma 2
target_statement: For a normalized finite-dimensional Gibbs law with sufficiently regular alpha-strongly convex potential, construct the canonical log-Sobolev inequality with constant alpha and derive the matching Talagrand T2 inequality, with explicit probability, P2, RN-density, KL and relative-Fisher domains suitable for the restricted-Gaussian fiber consumer.

consulted.hypothesis_adapter: Use the Euclidean Hessian lower bound to instantiate the Gibbs LSI constant, then derive T2 for arbitrary probability laws in the required P2/KL domain.
